pins.title: Set a turnaround time
pins.sub: Check today's sunset, then pick the time you turn back so you reach the car with daylight to spare. Turn on time, even short of the top.

pins.title: Short-day hiking checklist
items: Pack a headlamp, even at noon
Tell someone when you'll be back
pins.sub: Simple habits for November day hikes.

pins.title: Keep your phone for the map
pins.sub: The phone flashlight drains the battery you need for navigation. A headlamp keeps both hands free and the phone saved for the map.

pins.title: Free entry to US national parks
items: Camping and tours still cost extra
Check each park's page on nps.gov
pins.sub: Utah's parks stay open all winter. Pack layers: desert mornings can be freezing.

pins.title: Bring traction
items: The rim sits at about 8,000 ft
Main Road can close past mile 3
pins.sub: From the NPS winter page. Check current conditions before you drive.

pins.title: Small gifts under $13
pins.sub: Useful bits they will clip on and carry.

pins.title: Check your socks first
pins.sub: Cotton holds sweat and chills your feet. Merino wool wicks it away and stays warm when damp. Pack a dry spare pair.

pins.title: Stop the tube freezing
pins.sub: After every sip, blow the water back into the bladder. Keep the bladder against your back and carry a bottle as backup.
